BEFORE YOUR VISIT

What is payable in advance?+

The owner asks for one month’s rent in advance (₹7,500). There is no fixed security deposit. Confirm the payment date and all terms directly with the owner.

Is the flat ready to move into?+

The property is undergoing paintwork. Contact the owner to confirm the completion date and move-in availability.

What do the photos and walkthrough show?+

The walkthrough presents photographs in 3D space. It is not a 360° scan or a measured floor plan. Cleaned previews are AI-retouched photographs. Use “Show original photos” in the gallery to view the photos taken during paintwork.

How many rooms are there, and what is included?+

Please confirm the room count, floor area, furnishing, water and electricity arrangements, and any additional charges directly with the owner. The photographs show the available views, including repeated angles of the same spaces.
